### Fixed

- (muster, agent-platform, ui-react) [Keep the Workflows and Your sessions tables within their cards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3609) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The Workflows list no longer scrolls sideways beside the side rail, and the Your sessions tab's `By agent` table shows its token column headers in full; in narrower windows both tables drop a few columns and show those values under the name.
